profile.headline: AI & Graphics System software engineer at Nvidia

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
AI for Gaming & Graphics team

Projects:
- DLSS Ray Reconstruction

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
To solve bandwidth & limited quality issue in 360 video, we invented SuperStream 360 video system. I implemented three major technologies;

* Video converter converts a regular 360 video (equirectangular projection) into a SuperStream layout video.
Skills: Linux, C++, CUDA, nvdec, nvenc, ffmpeg libraries
My contribution: 30%

* Http streaming server sends converted video frames to clients.
Skills: Linux, C++, ffmpeg libraries
My contribution: 70%

* Android client renders the converted video frames correctly. To remove some artifacts introduced in conversion, some techniques are used in Vertex shader, Fragment shader, and alpha blending. 
Skills: OpenGL ES, Android, Java, C++, Google VR SDK, GearVR framework, Rajawali
My contribution: 100%

http://vr.alcacruz.com/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
DirectX core team, which develops DirectX 9/11/12 user mode drivers (nvd3dum[x]).dll and nvwgf2um[x].dll) on Windows OS.
* Triaged and fixed bugs reproduced in AAA games and Windows OS components, to make gamers and users happy.
* Implemented user mode drivers corresponding to DirectX API changes or hw changes. Key implementations;
 - DirectX 9 driver in Windows ARM (tegra) project (product : Microsoft Surface and Surface 2)
 - Residency Manager for wddmv2 in Windows 10.
* Involved in chip bringups : Kepler, Pascal

Skills: C++, DirectX, windbg, Visual Studio, Windows Kernel debugging, GPU debugging, gpuview, WHCK

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
DirectX core team
* Fixed bugs in DirectX user mode driver

positions.title: Game programmer
positions.description:
Crazy Arcade BnB development & publishing team
* A pc online game published in several countries. Still running.
* Fixed bugs in both server and client
* Implemented new game features
* Led migration to directx9

http://ca.nexon.com
